shellCommands.command: git status && git log --oneline | head && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100
for f in package.json index.html src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done
ls -la && ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -3; node -v; npm -v
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat package.json | grep '"version"' && ls && find . -path '*Theme*' -name '*.d.ts' | grep -v node_modules | head -30
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && cat ThemeProvider.d.ts ThemeProvider.js 2>/dev/null; ls; cat getThemeType.d.ts useThemeType.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat components/theme/types.d.ts components/theme/constants.js; grep -n "ThemeProvider\|useThemeType\|useThemeValue" components/theme/index.d.ts; grep -rn "export.*RadioButton\|export \* from './components'" index.d.ts components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls components | grep -i radio; cat components/controls/RadioButton/RadioButton.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60

cat components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; cat components/SegmentedRadioGroup/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -n "SegmentedRadioGroup\|ThemeProvider" index.d.ts components/index.d.ts | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && grep -n "ControlGroupProps\|ControlGroupOption" -A12 types.d.ts | head -60
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40

rm -rf dist; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -i playwright; python3 -c "import playwright" 2>&1 | tail -1

mkdir -p /tmp/e2e && cd /tmp/e2e && npm init -y >/dev/null && timeout 300 npm i playwright@1 --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -3 && timeout 400 npx playwright install --with-deps chromium 2>&1 | tail -5
cd /tmp/e2e && timeout 400 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -5; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null
(npx vite --port 5173 --strictPort > /tmp/e2e/vite.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; cat /tmp/e2e/vite.log | tail -5
cd /tmp/e2e && timeout 180 node check.mjs 2>&1 | tail -40

ls /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "glib|nss3|atk" | head; ls /lib/aarch64-linux-gnu 2>/dev/null | grep -i glib | head -3; find / -name "libglib-2.0.so*" 2>/dev/null | head -3; id -u
mkdir -p /tmp/debs && cd /tmp/debs && timeout 120 apt-get download libglib2.0-0t64 libpcre2-8-0 libffi8 2>&1 | tail -3; ls
cd /tmp/debs && cat /etc/os-release | head -2; (timeout 120 apt-get download libglib2.0-0 2>&1 | tail -2); ls; ls /var/lib/apt/lists 2>/dev/null | head -3

cd /tmp/debs && dpkg -x libglib2.0-0_*.deb /tmp/debs/root && find /tmp/debs/root -name "libglib-2.0.so*" | head -2 && H=$(ls -d ~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1254/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64) && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/debs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd $H/chrome-headless-shell | grep "not found"

cd /tmp/debs && timeout 300 apt-get download libnss3 libnspr4 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libx11-6 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxext6 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libxcb1 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libatspi2.0-0 libcups2 libpango-1.0-0 libcairo2 libxrender1 libxi6 libxcursor1 libxss1 libpangocairo-1.0-0 libexpat1 libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libpng16-16 libpixman-1-0 libxcb-shm0 libxcb-render0 libxshmfence1 libdrm2 libwayland-client0 libxtst6 libxau6 libxdmcp6 libgcc-s1 libstdc++6 libbsd0 libmd0 libnettle8 libgnutls30 libhogweed6 libtasn1-6 libp11-kit0 libidn2-0 libunistring2 libffi8 libpcre2-8-0 libmount1 libselinux1 libblkid1 libsystemd0 libcap2 libgmp10 libsqlite3-0 libuuid1 libz3-4 libzstd1 libjpeg62-turbo liblcms2-2 libwebp7 libharfbuzz0b libthai0 libdatrie1 libgraphite2-3 libfribidi0 libxinerama1 libxkbfile1 libasyncns0 libflac12 libogg0 libvorbis0a libvorbisenc2 libsndfile1 libpulse0 libcap2 2>&1 | tail -2; for f in *.deb; do dpkg -x "$f" /tmp/debs/root; done; H=$(ls -d ~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1254/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64); LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/debs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd $H/chrome-headless-shell | grep "not found"; echo done

cd /tmp/debs && timeout 200 apt-get download libdbus-1-3 libwayland-server0 2>&1 | tail -1; for f in libdbus-1-3*.deb libwayland-server0*.deb; do dpkg -x "$f" /tmp/debs/root; done; H=$(ls -d ~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1254/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64); LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/debs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd $H/chrome-headless-shell | grep "not found"; echo ok
cd /tmp/debs && ls | grep -i dbus; timeout 200 apt-get download libdbus-1-3 2>&1 | tail -2; ls /tmp/debs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu | grep -i dbus; find /tmp/debs/root -name "libdbus*" | head

H=$(ls -d ~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1254/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64); export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/debs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/debs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$LD_LIBRARY_PATH ldd $H/chrome-headless-shell | grep "not found"; echo "missing-check-done"; cd /tmp/e2e && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$LD_LIBRARY_PATH timeout 200 node check.mjs 2>&1 | tail -30
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/debs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/debs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; cd /tmp/e2e && timeout 200 node check.mjs 2>&1 | tail -30
pkill -f "vite --port 5173" ; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && git status --short && git diff --stat && ls
for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do if grep -q "vite" $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null && grep -q "5173" $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null; then kill $(basename $p) && echo "killed $(basename $p)"; fi; done; echo ok
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5173/ || echo "server down"

for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *vite*) echo "$(basename $p): $c"; kill $(basename $p);; esac; done; sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5173/ || echo "server down"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5173/ || echo "server down"; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && git status --short
